def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a single relative file name with no path separators or dot-dot parts."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../secret.txt") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or ":" in name:
        return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the notes directory.
    A missing or unreadable file gives "". No name, including absolute or
    ".." paths, may read a file outside notes."""
    pre is_plain_name(name)
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read(name) else ""
        return text
